l-m-m3-b01-10.goal: Sarudza kuti ndeupi muyero (ruzivo) unodiwa chaizvo kuwana mamiriro ekushandura x²+bx+c kuita (x+p)(x+q), uye utsanangure kuti wasarudza sei.

l-m-m3-b01-10.s.s1.r.d: Coefficient ye x i p+q, kwete p−q.
l-m-m3-b01-10.s.s1.explain: (x+p)(x+q)=x²+(p+q)x+pq, saka tsvaga nhamba mbiri dzine p+q=b ne pq=c.
l-m-m3-b01-10.s.s2.model.0: Kutambanudza (x+p)(x+q) kunopa x²+(p+q)x+pq, saka coefficient b ye x inofanira kuva p+q uye constant term c inofanira kuva pq.
l-m-m3-b01-10.s.s2.model.1: Kufananidza expression yakatambanudzwa nemacoefficients e x²+bx+c, huwandu hunofanira kuva b uye product inofanira kuva c, saka huwandu neproduct zvenhamba mbiri ndiyo kiyi.

l-m-m3-b02-10.material: Kune natural number n, tinoda kuziva kana √n i natural number. Takanyora n seproduct ye prime factors, sa 12=2²×3, 36=2²×3², ne 200=2³×5².

l-m-m3-b02-10.s.s1.explain: Kana ma exponents e prime factors ose i even, ipapo n i square number uye √n i natural number. 36 i 2²×3².
l-m-m3-b02-10.s.s2.model.0: Kana ma exponents e prime factors ose i even, n inogona kunyorwa se (nhamba imwe)², saka √n i natural number.
l-m-m3-b02-10.s.s2.model.1: 12 ine exponent ye 1 ye 3, uye 200 ine exponent ye 3 ye 2, saka imwe neimwe ine exponent i odd, zvichireva kuti √n haisi natural number.

l-m-m3-b05-25.s.s2.model.0: Sezvo 3 = mumvuri × 1.7, mumvuri i3÷1.7 ≈ 1.8 m, ipfupi kupfuura tsvimbo uye inokodzera hurefu hwezuva we60°.
l-m-m3-b05-25.s.s2.model.1: Sezvo tan 60° ikuru kupfuura 1, mumvuri unofanira kuva pfupi kupfuura hurefu hwe3 m, uye 3÷1.7 ≈ 1.8 m inokodzera.

l-m-m3-b04-34.goal: Tevedza nedanho mhinduro inoshandisa inscribed angle padiameter, kana cheni yayo yechikonzero nemhedzisiro, uye utsvage uye ugadzirise nzvimbo yekutanga inokanganisa.
l-m-m3-b04-34.material: Iyi mhinduro yekutsvaga ∠BAC kana AB iri diameter yedenderedzwa uye ∠ABC=35°. ① Sezvo AB iri diameter, ∠ACB=90°. ② ∠BAC=180°−35°=145°. ③ ∠BAC=145°.
l-m-m3-b04-34.s.s1.r.a: Inscribed angle padiameter ndi 90°, saka ① yakarurama.
l-m-m3-b04-34.s.s1.r.c: ③ inobva pakukosha kwe ②. Kanganiso yekutanga ndi ②.

l-m-m3-b04-34.s.s1.explain: Huwandu hwemakona emukati etriangle ndi 180°, saka ∠BAC=180°−90°−35°=55°.
l-m-m3-b04-34.s.s2.model.0: Mu ②, ∠ACB=90° inofanirawo kubviswa, asi 35° chete ndiyo yakabviswa, saka yakanganisa. Igadzirise kuva 180°−90°−35°=55°.
l-m-m3-b04-34.s.s2.model.1: Huwandu hwemakona matatu etriangle ndi 180°, saka ∠BAC=180°−90°−35°, uye ② ndiko kukanganisa kwekutanga.
